milestone: Fix Text Rotation to spin in place around its real center, not orbit around its declared box
slice: Real, user-reported bug found the same session the Text Rotation feature shipped: "you have implemented rotation. we need spin... the current rotation is moving the object all around the canvas in circular motion. the rotation needs to be able to rotate the object 360 degree tied down at its centre. like we did for image, like we have in studio." Root cause, confirmed by direct code read: engineRuntime.js's _paintLayer text branch rotated around the Layer's declared box (rect, from rectFor()) -- correct for Image/Shape Decorations, whose declared box IS their visible content, but a Text Layer's declared box is only ever a wrap-width/creation-time placeholder height (textFootprint()'s own AV-006/AV-010 doc comment), completely decoupled from where the real glyphs sit once actual content exists. Pivoting on that declared box's own center swung the visible text through a wide arc around empty space as the angle changed. Fixed by pivoting on textFootprint()'s own real, measured center instead -- the identical extent this module already reports for hit-testing/dragging -- matching how root Studio's own _layerDrawText already rotates around a point derived from real content, never a raw declared box. Verified via real pixel sampling (not just a ctx.rotate angle spy): rendered a short string in a large declared box at 0deg and 180deg and measured the actual painted ink's own center -- a stationary pivot must leave that center essentially unchanged across a 180deg turn. A git-stash A/B confirmed the unmodified baseline showed a 711px center drift (the reported bug, reproduced exactly); the fix reduces it to 22px, landing within 11.5px of the real footprint center versus 356px away from the old declared-box center. Full regression: the original 22-assertion Text Rotation Playwright suite passes unchanged, and both goldenBuild.js suites (30/30 each) pass unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to one function, _paintLayer, in tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/engineRuntime.js.
